$comment: Four-gate acceptance loop (T0012, docs/67). G1 is enforced by `rddev worker collect` (RESULT consistency, worker boundary); G2 re-runs CI's EXACT steps — the six jobs of .github/workflows/ci.yml, steps verbatim (a sync unit test fails when this file drifts from ci.yml); G4 (merge gate) asserts EVERY required job is green in the task's latest G2 record. G3 is per-task integration/E2E via task_overrides (absent = not required, recorded as such, never silently skipped).

G1.name: Worker local gate
G1.description: The Worker ran the task's required tests and its RESULT is internally consistent. Enforced mechanically by `rddev worker collect`: a completed claim with not_run/failed tests, an INTERIM-marked RESULT, or a failed/blocked RESULT is rejected.

G2.name: Supervisor acceptance gate
G2.description: CI's exact steps re-run locally by the Supervisor before accept. `rddev task accept` runs (or reuses a fresh) G2 record and refuses the verification -> accepted transition on any red job. This is the fix for the red-PR merge: G2 is never a similar-looking subset.

G3.name: Integration / E2E gate
G3.description: Cross-boundary checks against real services, defined per task in task_overrides (docs/67). A task without a G3 entry has G3 recorded as not_required.

G4.name: Merge gate
G4.description: Asserts EVERY required CI job is green in the task's latest G2 record (and that the record postdates the collect that verified the task). `rddev pr merge` runs this and refuses to merge while any required job is red or missing.
